methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.

original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read PROOF.md and AUDIT.md in #4100. Select one distinct obligation: CRT total repair, native/free-algebra lifting, precision/conditioning, or complete fixed-tape cost. This is an author-submitted proof, not an accepted unconditional theorem.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: Check live handoffs; name one proposition, its caller, quantified domain and dependency closure. Independently prove the implication or exhibit a precise gap/counterexample. Prioritize CRT.md total repair or COMPLEX.md free-algebra lift only if unclaimed. Stop at the chosen obligation; do not substitute finite samples or root arithmetic for an all-size proof, or launch the complete package by default.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: proposed unconditional construction and finite checks, without independent acceptance.
existing_checks.remaining: Independent proof audit of one caller-bound all-size implication; all other premises remain explicit.

actual_scope: Lower the actual rational FFT and the complete conditioned Toeplitz program with its stored inverse through retained six-H words and Benes routing, preserving stage counts and proving explicit coefficient, data-rounding and signed-width bounds.
scope_change_reason: The completed FFT connection does not consume the full source's nonunitary scalar and shear gates. I preserve that checkpoint and its receipt, reuse the retained zero-safe words, bind the full logical prefix contract to the same admitted root, and add the endpoint factor and upstream coefficient defect required by the new rounded execution. The scaled zero-shear counterexample distinguishes this obligation from the FFT-only proof. I compared the remaining core/halo reference and ownership connection before choosing this interface.
bottleneck_link: The Gaussian caller cannot use the fixed-H tensor compiler until its actual rational gates have a source-bound lowering and numerical entrance/output contract. This contribution addresses that local connection; physical root, tensor and tape admission remain separate.
stop_rule: Stop at a wrong exact endpoint, pair orientation, inactive-word normalization, source-order mismatch, uncharged coefficient or data rounding term, or understated word width. Preserve the completed PR4205 checkpoint and do not infer physical execution from fixed-H arithmetic.
evidence: The unchanged RESULT.json retains the completed FFT evidence: 13 cases, 2,525 native stages, 73,104 rounded outputs and 23 controls. DENSE-PROOF.md binds the source-conditioned full program and stored inverse to endpoint-sensitive native error below the remaining half-budget, giving total error below 2^-t and signed widths O(F0+t+log N+log lambda+log Q+log R). DENSE-RESULT.json records 11 root cases in both directions, 146,262 stages, 992,742 rounded outputs, four generic cases, 24 shear words and 2,184 segments/inverses, plus admission and mutation controls. I compare same-root exact references, retained logical outputs, reversed wires, fine incoming data and a calibrated missing-endpoint-factor counterexample. The source prefix and phase contracts remain explicit author-proved dependencies; physical T74 execution remains open.
